scientific_integrity.analytical_basis: Independent exponential cycle lengths, beta Gaussian mixture, dominated convergence of the normal tail, marked Poisson convergence, independent Gaussian marks.
scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Joint marked extreme-value limit for pre-reset harmonic potential energy, sharp tail, critical exponential-moment threshold, and reset-cycle duration selection.
scientific_integrity.numerical_role: Finite special-function and integral checks support the algebra, not infinite-limit proof.
scientific_integrity.prior_work_acknowledgement: The OU transition law, stationary reset density, classical Gumbel/marked-Poisson methods, and distinct physical erasure work results are previously known.

scientific_limitations: One-dimensional overdamped Ornstein–Uhlenbeck diffusion, independent homogeneous Poisson complete resets to zero.
Dimensionless harmonic potential energy immediately before idealized resets is not identified with implementation-dependent thermodynamic work.
Limits concern the number of complete reset cycles tending to infinity; no convergence rates, physical erasure protocol or continuous-path extreme-value theorem is asserted.
No independent priority or scientific validation is asserted.
title: A Gumbel–Gamma law for reset-event harmonic energy extremes and their selected cycle ages
